verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שָׂ֭מַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֑י בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה נֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: šîr ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ śā·maḥ·tî bə·’ō·mə·rîm lî bêṯ Yah·weh nê·lêḵ
verses.literal: A song of ascents Of David I was glad when they said to me Let us go to the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Regozijei-me quando me disseram: Vamos à Casa de Jeová.

verses.literal: Our feet are standing . . . in your gates O Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Os nossos pés estão parados dentro das tuas portas, Jerusalém.

verses.original: יְרוּשָׁלִַ֥ם הַבְּנוּיָ֑ה כְּ֝עִ֗יר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה־ לָּ֥הּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: yə·rū·šā·lim hab·bə·nū·yāh kə·‘îr še·ḥub·bə·rāh- lāh yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together
verses.literalPt: Jerusalém que és edificada como uma cidade compacta,

verses.original: שֶׁשָּׁ֨ם עָל֪וּ שְׁבָטִ֡ים שִׁבְטֵי־ יָ֭הּ עֵד֣וּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ֝הֹד֗וֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šeš·šām ‘ā·lū šə·ḇā·ṭîm šiḇ·ṭê- yāh ‘ê·ḏūṯ lə·yiś·rā·’êl lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ lə·šêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: where the tribes go up the tribes of the LORD as a testimony for Israel to give thanks to the name of the LORD
verses.literalPt: aonde sobem as tribos, as tribos de Jeová, como testemunho a Israel, para darem graças ao nome de Jeová.

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁ֨מָּה׀ יָשְׁב֣וּ כִסְא֣וֹת לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֝סְא֗וֹת לְבֵ֣ית דָּוִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: kî šām·māh yā·šə·ḇū ḵis·’ō·wṯ lə·miš·pāṭ kis·’ō·wṯ lə·ḇêṯ dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: For there the thrones of judgment stand the thrones of the house of David
verses.literalPt: Pois ali estão postos os tronos de julgar, os tronos da casa de Davi.

verses.literal: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem May those who love you prosper
verses.literalPt: Orai pela paz de Jerusalém. Gozem de prosperidade os que te amam.

verses.literal: May there be peace within your walls and prosperity inside your fortresses
verses.literalPt: Haja paz dentro dos teus muros, e prosperidade, nos teus palácios.

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן אַחַ֣י וְרֵעָ֑י אֲדַבְּרָה־ נָּ֖א שָׁל֣וֹם בָּֽךְ׃
verses.literal: For the sake of my brothers and friends I will say . . . Peace be within you
verses.literalPt: Por amor dos meus irmãos e amigos, diga eu: Haja paz dentro de ti.

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן בֵּית־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁ֖ה ט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃
verses.literal: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God I will seek your prosperity
verses.literalPt: Por amor da Casa de Jeová, nosso Deus, buscarei o teu bem.
